Paul remembers their work of faith, labour of love and steadfastness of hope. Which of these is growing in you?
They received the word in much affliction with joy from the Holy Spirit. How can joy and affliction go together?
They turned to God from idols to serve the living God. What did you turn from when you came to God?
Paul shared not only the gospel but his own self. How can you share your life with others, not just words?
Paul encouraged them like a father to walk worthy of God. Who encourages you this way?
They received God's word not as human words but as the word of God. How do you receive the Bible?
Paul called them his glory and joy. Who are the people you rejoice over in the faith?
Paul sent Timothy to strengthen and encourage them in affliction. Who could you strengthen this week?
Their faith and love brought Paul comfort and joy. How might your faith encourage others?
Paul prays the Lord would make them increase in love for one another. Pray this for your fellowship.
This is the will of God, your sanctification. What does living a holy life look like for you?
Paul says to aspire to live quietly and work with your hands. What would a quiet, faithful life look like?
We do not grieve as those who have no hope. How does Jesus' return comfort you in grief?
We are children of light, so let us be sober and encourage one another. How can you encourage someone today?
Paul says to admonish the idle, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak and be patient. Which is most needed around you?
"Rejoice always, pray without ceasing, give thanks in all circumstances." Which of these is hardest for you?
"He who calls you is faithful; he will surely do it." What do you need God to complete in you?
